2026_01_CLE_JAX.headline: Cleveland’s rebuilt line faces Jacksonville’s speed before either offense can settle in
2026_01_CLE_JAX.paragraph1: Cleveland will start rookie Austin Barber at right guard as part of an entirely rebuilt offensive line, creating an early test against Jacksonville’s front and a Jaguars defense featuring Travis Hunter’s return. The Browns need clean first-down execution to keep their quarterback from absorbing predictable pressure. Jacksonville has its own tackle uncertainty around Cole Van Lanen, so Myles Garrett and Cleveland’s rush can answer in kind. Whichever protection unit handles movement and pressure better should determine whether this becomes a controlled game or a turnover-driven opener.
2026_01_CLE_JAX.model_rationale: Both offenses carry protection questions, so the more reliable path belongs to the defense that creates negative plays without surrendering explosive answers behind the rush.
